basic_info.description: Step into the timeless charm of The Hamilton, a stunning historic Art Deco building in the heart of San Francisco. From the moment you enter the opulent lobby, you'll appreciate the building's rich architectural details, beautifully preserved common areas, 24-hour doorperson service, a well-equipped fitness center, and a rooftop deck with sweeping city viewsperfect for sunset gatherings or a quiet moment above the bustle.  Unit #812 blends classic character with thoughtful updates. The recently remodeled kitchen has been opened to the living area, featuring a stylish bar that adds valuable counter space while maintaining a clean layoutideal for entertaining or relaxed everyday living. The living space also features a designated spot for mounting a TV, ample natural light, and a period charm throughout. Peekaboo city views add to the ambiance.  Centrally located near downtown, Union Square, and public transit, this home puts the entire city within easy reach. Bonus: HOA dues cover all utilities, making budgeting easier.
